description.fr-FR: Trente-trois méditations pour la retraite annuelle des Sœurs de la Visitation, tirées des écrits de saint François de Sales et disposées par sainte Jeanne-Françoise de Chantal en trois points, avec des affections ; précédées de son avis aux Sœurs, et suivies de sa lettre à la Mère de Châtel sur les solitudes et de l’examen pour les confessions annuelles. Terminées à Annecy le 15 août 1637.
description.en-US: Thirty-three meditations for the annual retreat of the Sisters of the Visitation, taken from the writings of St. Francis de Sales and arranged by St. Jane Frances de Chantal in three points with affections; preceded by her note to the Sisters and followed by her letter to Mother de Châtel on retreats and the examen for annual confessions. Completed at Annecy on 15 August 1637.
description.pt-BR: Trinta e três meditações para o retiro anual das Irmãs da Visitação, tiradas dos escritos de são Francisco de Sales e dispostas por santa Joana Francisca de Chantal em três pontos, com afetos; precedidas do seu aviso às Irmãs e seguidas da carta à Madre de Châtel sobre os retiros e do exame para as confissões anuais.

fr-FR.editor: Religieuses du Premier Monastère de la Visitation d’Annecy

sources.edition: Sainte Jeanne-Françoise Frémyot de Chantal, sa vie et ses œuvres, Plon, Paris, 1876, tome III (Œuvres diverses II), pp. 1–92 (reproducing the 1642 edition). Archive.org OCR of the Sainte-Geneviève copy.
sources.description: OCR cleaned by script. The points are marked; the "affections" stay inside the points. The meditations are substantially Francis de Sales’s text, arranged by Jane de Chantal.

sources.edition: Meditations for Retreats, taken from the writings of St. Francis de Sales, arranged by St. Jane Frances Fremiot de Chantal, from the French by a Visitandine of Baltimore, Benziger Brothers, New York, 1900. Google scan, archive.org OCR.
sources.description: OCR cleaned by script; the Benziger Brothers’ catalogue pages at the end are left out. The English follows the French in chapters 1–33, the letter and the examen.
